status: Candidate not adopted; empirical response compression remains unresolved.
hypothesis: Unrelated worked biographies may anchor generated food preferences because one dislikes cold foods and another likes warm soup.
intervention: Remove the unrelated worked biographies and replace only their output-format cross-reference with a description of allowed JSON structures. Preserve population eligibility, sampled characteristics, required fields and all actor inputs apart from the new biography.

corrected_screen.semantic_review: All six public replies and the corresponding culinary elaborations were read. Both arms retained the sampled adventurous, traditional or mild/familiar food preferences. The replies remained cautious about bottled gazpacho. Gabriel's 1-to-2 shift alone is not evidence of improved calibration.

earlier_harness_mismatch.cause_of_protocol_mismatch: The replay harness omitted the factory's response_format=json_object setting in both generator arms.
earlier_harness_mismatch.interpretation: The malformed response occurred outside the production request contract; it is not evidence that the production factory regressed. The failed output and cost were retained without repairing or redrawing it. The comparison was rerun in a separate folder after correcting the harness.

cost_scope: Twenty-three saved returned responses across these two screens, including the malformed response. Saved list rates and returned usage, not invoices or project-wide spending.
retrospective_population_scope_caveat: The earlier three population-scope generator replays also omitted production JSON mode. They remain exploratory content checks. The two real-factory core cases and the completed 434-case production suite independently exercised production JSON mode and remain valid.
limitations: One new stochastic biography per condition per person; not a precise causal effect estimate.
Regenerating biographies permits new life details, so these are not unchanged-persona comparisons.
This is not a new complete notebook rollout, a quality-corrected trajectory, a representative population sample or a held-out human comparison.
A higher mean or a change from 1 to 2 is not a success criterion.
These results do not prove that worked examples have no effect; they do not establish removal as a solution.
